help.title: Help & FAQ
help.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions landlords ask most. Can't find yours? Email us below.
help.unitsQuestion: How are "units" counted when I add a property?
help.unitsAnswer: It's based on property type: a single-family home or condo counts as 1 unit, a duplex as 2, a triplex as 3, and a fourplex as 4. Your plan's unit cap applies to your total across every property you own, not just one.
help.tenantSetupQuestion: How do I get a tenant set up on the portal?
help.tenantSetupAnswer: Add the tenant under their property, then use the tenant's menu to invite them to the tenant portal. That sends them a login so they can view their lease, payment history, and message you directly.
help.collectRentQuestion: Does Praedium collect rent from my tenants?
help.collectRentAnswer: Not yet — you record each rent payment yourself once it's received, and Praedium tracks the history for you. Tenants don't pay through the app.
help.remindersAnswer: Yes. Praedium texts a friendly reminder 3 days before rent is due, and a follow-up if it's still showing unpaid a couple of days after.
help.filesAnswer: PDFs, Word documents, and images (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC), up to 15MB per file.
help.maintenanceAnswer: Tenants submit requests from their portal with a description and an optional photo. They show up on your Maintenance page as Open, and you can move them to In Progress or Resolved as you handle them.
help.renewalSoonAnswer: A lease is flagged once Quebec's TAL notice window actually opens or has passed without a notice sent -- that's 3-6 months before a lease of 12+ months ends, 1-2 months before a shorter fixed-term lease ends, and 1-2 months before a month-to-month tenant's planned change date (once you've set one). See the Lease Renewals page for each tenant's exact window.
help.textTenantQuestion: How do I text a tenant?
help.textTenantAnswer: The Messages page is a shared inbox for SMS with all your tenants — send, read, and keep a record of every conversation in one place.
help.planIncludesAnswer: Starter covers up to 5 units, Growth up to 20, and Portfolio is unlimited. Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial — we collect a card upfront, but you're not charged until the trial ends.
help.exportDeleteQuestion: Can I export or delete my data?
help.exportDeleteAnswer: Yes — from Settings you can download a copy of your account data anytime, or request account deletion. Deleting your account sends you an email and text with a link to undo it, and gives you 7 days to change your mind before it's final.
help.reachSupportAnswerSuffix: — it's actively monitored, and we aim to respond within 24 hours.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.section1Para1: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") govern your use of Praedium (the "Service"), a rental property management tool for landlords: it helps you track properties and tenants, record rent payments, send SMS notifications, store lease documents, and generate income/expense reports.
termsOfService.section1Para2: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for all activity that happens under your account.
termsOfService.section2Para1: Praedium is offered in three monthly subscription tiers, billed in CAD: Starter ($39/month, up to 5 units), Growth ($149/month, up to 20 units), and Portfolio ($299/month, unlimited units) (together, the "Plans"). Every Plan includes a 30-day free trial. A payment card is required to start your trial, but you won't be charged until the trial period ends. Your subscription automatically renews each month until you cancel it, and you can switch between Plans at any time from your account.
termsOfService.section2Para2: Cancelling stops future billing but doesn't refund the current billing period. Payments are processed by Stripe — Praedium never sees your full card number. We may change our prices, but we'll give you notice before any change affects you.
termsOfService.section3Para1: You own the data you put into Praedium ("Your Data") — your property details, tenant information, payment records, and documents. We don't sell it.
termsOfService.section3Para2: As a landlord using Praedium, you're responsible for having the legal right to store your tenants' personal information under applicable privacy law (including Quebec's Law 25) and for informing your tenants accordingly.
termsOfService.section3Para3: You can export Your Data (as a downloadable JSON file, covering your properties, tenants, payments, documents, expenses, maintenance requests, vendors, and SMS history) before closing your account. After closure, we retain it briefly and then delete it, as described in our Privacy Policy.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.section1Para1: This policy covers both landlords who create a Praedium account and their tenants, who don't create accounts themselves but whose information landlords enter into the Service.
privacyPolicy.section1Para2Prefix: Under Quebec's Law 25, every organization handling personal information must designate a person in charge of the protection of personal information. For Praedium, that person is Felix, reachable at
privacyPolicy.section2Row1Why: Account creation, security, and billing contact
privacyPolicy.section2Row2Why: Handled by Stripe — Praedium never stores your full card number
privacyPolicy.section2Row3What: Property/tenant info you enter (addresses, names, phone, email, lease dates, rent)
privacyPolicy.section2Row5Why: Retrieval when you need them — never shared outside your account
privacyPolicy.section2Row7What: Usage data (login times, pages visited, error logs)
privacyPolicy.section2Para2: Tenant information is collected from the landlord, not directly from tenants — obtaining tenant consent for this is the landlord's responsibility, as described in our Terms of Service.
privacyPolicy.section3Intro: We don't sell your data or share it with advertisers. We do share it with the providers that make Praedium work:
privacyPolicy.section3Item5: Anthropic (Claude), which drafts the text of some automated messages — it sees the tenant's name and payment amount for that purpose only
privacyPolicy.section3Para2: Cross-border transfer: none of these providers are based in Quebec, so your data is processed on servers outside Quebec (commonly the United States). Quebec's Law 25 requires confirming that data transferred outside Quebec receives protection equivalent to what Quebec law provides. We've reviewed each provider's published security practices — all are established providers that publish data processing agreements, encrypt data in transit and at rest, and maintain independent security certifications (such as SOC 2) — and consider this protection equivalent. We keep this assessment under periodic review as providers or their practices change.
privacyPolicy.section3Para3: We may also disclose information if legally required to, or to protect rights, safety, or property.
privacyPolicy.section4Title: 4. How we protect it, and how long we keep it
privacyPolicy.section4Para1: Each account's data is isolated and checked on every request. Uploaded documents are stored privately and accessed only through short-lived, single-use links — never public URLs. All data is encrypted in transit over HTTPS.
privacyPolicy.section4Para2: We keep your data while your account is active. After you close your account, we retain it briefly (to handle billing disputes or accidental deletion) and then delete it, except for records we're legally required to keep longer, like payment records.
privacyPolicy.section4Para3: If a data breach affects your information, we'll notify Quebec's Commission d'accès à l'information (CAI) and any affected individuals as required by law.
privacyPolicy.section5Para1: Landlords can access, correct, export, or delete their account data at any time from the dashboard, or by contacting us.
privacyPolicy.section5Para2Prefix: Tenants have rights under Quebec law to know about, get a copy of, correct, or withdraw consent for their personal information (withdrawing consent may limit the landlord's ability to manage the tenancy through the Service). The fastest way to exercise these rights is usually to ask your landlord directly, but you can also contact
privacyPolicy.section5Para3: You also have the right to file a complaint with the CAI.
privacyPolicy.section6LocalStorage: we use your browser's local storage to keep you signed in and to remember your cookie preference.
privacyPolicy.section6Children: Praedium is a business tool not intended for use by anyone under 18, and we don't knowingly collect information from children.
privacyPolicy.section6Changes: we'll notify active users of any material change before it takes effect.
privacyPolicy.section6ContactPrefix: questions, requests, or complaints about this policy or your personal information can be sent to
privacyPolicy.section6Cookies: with your consent, given through the cookie banner, we use Google Analytics to understand how Praedium is used. If you decline or don't respond, no analytics cookies are set and nothing is sent to Google.

payment.trialNote: Card required to start your trial — you won't be charged for 30 days. Cancel anytime before then and you won't be billed.
payment.faqUnitA: Every rental unit across all your properties — a single-family home counts as 1, a duplex as 2, a fourplex as 4, and so on. Your plan is based on your total across your whole portfolio, not the number of properties.
payment.faqOverLimitQ: What happens if I go over my plan's limit?
payment.faqOverLimitA: You won't be able to add a new property or unit past your plan's cap — you'll be prompted to upgrade first. Your existing data is never affected.

payment.faqChangeA: Yes, you can switch plans anytime from this page. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period.
payment.faqMethodsQ: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.faqMethodsA: We accept all major credit and debit cards via Stripe.
